# Alexis Rondeau

> Everything I publish, in the order I published it: posts from Twitter and notes from my vault, archived here in full — text, images, video and links — so they outlive the platforms.

Canonical home: https://alexisrondeau.me/ · Twitter: https://x.com/SpringStreetNYC
